comment: Template exclusion lists for different test types. 'exclude_list' contains permanent exclusions that apply to all tests. 'main_test_exclude_list' contains games excluded from spoiler-minimal and multiclient tests. 'worldgen_test_exclude_list' contains games excluded from world-generator tests. This file is loaded by scripts/lib/test_utils.py.

exclude_list.name: Final Fantasy.yaml
exclude_list.reason: Requires manual configuration and is not compatible with automated testing.

exclude_list.name: Ocarina of Time.yaml
exclude_list.reason: The default yaml file fails to generate.

exclude_list.name: Sudoku.yaml
exclude_list.reason: Cannot be used for generating worlds.

exclude_list.name: Zillion.yaml
exclude_list.reason: Uses the external zilliandomizer tool for its logic, which is not compatible with this system.

main_test_exclude_list.name: Jak and Daxter The Precursor Legacy.yaml
main_test_exclude_list.reason: Temporarily excluded. It takes too long to process. 200 seconds for the spoiler test.

main_test_exclude_list.reason: Temporarily excluded. It takes too long to process. 120 seconds for the spoiler test.

main_test_exclude_list.name: Pokemon Red and Blue.yaml
main_test_exclude_list.reason: Temporarily excluded. It takes too long to process. 61 seconds for the multiclient test.

main_test_exclude_list.name: SMZ3.yaml
main_test_exclude_list.reason: Temporarily excluded. It takes too long to process. 186 seconds for the multiclient test, which also fails because of self-locking items.

main_test_exclude_list.name: TUNIC.yaml
main_test_exclude_list.reason: Temporarily excluded. There is a recursion issue in the exporter that makes it never stop writing to the output file.
